stadium_owner.detail: Owned by San Mames Barria S.L., in which Athletic Club holds 30.09% (no control: decisions need a 90% majority) alongside Kutxabank, the Basque Government, the Diputación Foral de Bizkaia and Bilbao city council. Athletic paid about EUR 50m of the EUR 189m cost and uses the stadium under a 50-year concession with an annual fee indexed to inflation (EUR 574,836.63 in 2022-23), with a EUR 66m purchase option in 2063 (Relevo).

name: Athletic Club
notes: Member-owned: no ownership transactions, minority investments or debt financings since 2015 were found; the club has no financial debt (Marca, Sep 2026: 'sin endeudamiento', liquidity EUR 94m including an undrawn credit line, equity EUR 112.8m), so net_debt is left blank rather than given as a figure no page states. Athletic, with Real Madrid, Barcelona and Ibiza, voted against the LaLiga-CVC 'Impulso' deal on 10 Dec 2021 (Heraldo) and took no CVC money. Revenue is the club's 2025-26 total excluding player sales (EUR 192.9m, up EUR 20.4m); the audited 2024-25 accounts show net turnover (importe neto de la cifra de negocios) of EUR 166,399,358 and a net profit of EUR 6,980,736. 2025-26 net profit: EUR 20.6m. The club's own website (athletic-club.eus) sits behind a bot challenge, so club figures are cited from its CDN-hosted accounts PDF or from Marca. Not in Forbes' 2026 top 30, and no other published valuation found. No named corporate chief executive found (Mikel González is director general of football, renewed to 2030). Not found: valuation, social follower counts.

ownership_summary: Athletic Club is a private non-profit sports association (not a sociedad anónima deportiva) owned and governed by its members, who exercise sovereignty through the General Assembly; it had 43,834 members at 30 June 2025. There is no private, fund or institutional shareholder, and the club voted against and stayed out of the 2021 LaLiga-CVC deal. Its only equity holding of note is 30.09% of San Mames Barria S.L., the stadium company.
